title: mimi-server: /notify parser panics on truncated opaque<V> in debug builds
description: crate-jmap-chat-mimi-server/src/fanout.rs reads FanoutMessage tails (moreProposals, externalProposals, frank, RatchetTreeOption full/httpsUri) with tls_codec 0.5.0 DeserializeBytes. VLBytes::tls_deserialize_bytes on a truncated vector hits debug_assert_eq! (quic_vec.rs:370, 'Expected to read N bytes but M were read') instead of returning Err, so a hub-supplied /notify body can panic a debug build; release returns Err. Found while implementing JMAP-6k5d.5, whose wire.rs uses the Read-based Deserialize path for this reason. Fix: switch fanout.rs's skip_tail/skip_ratchet_tree_option to Deserialize over &mut &[u8] (as wire.rs::read does), and add a parse_fanout_messages test with a truncated moreProposals<V>.
close_reason: Batch 11: committed and adversarially verified (or already fixed); CI green at cc87669d
